name: Median Technologies SA
summary: Median Technologies SA develops and markets software solutions and services for the use of medical images for the diagnosis and monitoring of patients with cancer in Europe, North America, and Asia. The company offers iCRO, an imaging service for oncology clinical trials; and eyonis, an end-to-end CADe/CADx software as medical devices. The company was founded in 2002 and is based in Valbonne, France.
